name: python-ml-agent
title: Python ML Pipeline
description: Python 3.11+ ML pipeline: collector → features → models → decisions → actions, with scikit-learn/PyTorch, SQLite, autonomy gating, and typed CLI.

registry.note: Distilled from a self-learning macOS performance agent. The standout idea is the autonomy model (auto/ask/never) for destructive actions — a pattern any ML-driven automation project should steal.
